# Pursuit Managed Services

> Three single-file HTML pages (participant, admin, setup), built with Svelte 5, that run from a SharePoint document folder and keep their data in SharePoint lists. No server.

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): start here: commands, folder map, rules, how to make a common change
- [docs/project-map.json](docs/project-map.json): the project in one machine-readable file (stack, pages, lists, question types, commands, gates, folders)
- [docs/MODULES.md](docs/MODULES.md): the module map, generated from the code
- [docs/DATA-FLOW.md](docs/DATA-FLOW.md): from a tap to a list item to a chart to a file
- [docs/SHAREPOINT.md](docs/SHAREPOINT.md): the lists, pms-config.txt, Setup, what SharePoint does, deployment
- [SHAREPOINT-LISTS.md](SHAREPOINT-LISTS.md): every list and column, generated from the schema
- [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md): what still binds, and what enforces it
- [docs/RULES.md](docs/RULES.md): the rule book, by part and phase
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): what each gate proves
- [docs/HISTORY.md](docs/HISTORY.md): the phases and their reports
- [README.md](README.md): for people
